# BlueCrest (bluecreast.in)
> High-integrity multi-niche publication covering technology, personal finance, preventive medicine, modern lifestyle, and Indian venture ecosystems.

## Core Mission & Editorial Standards
BlueCrest publishes peer-reviewed and practitioner-authored journalism. We specialize in deep-dive architectures, reproducible benchmarks, and evidence-backed explainers.
All content is original, authored by domain specialists (MDs, PhDs, CFAs), and fact-checked under our Editorial Policy.
